post.originalText:
Gemini 4 Pro vs GPT-6 Astra

Same prompt: 3D Apache helicopter in three.js

Gemini 4 Pro: cleaner flight, rotor motion actually reads right
GPT-6 Astra: more detail + full control panel
tbh both cooked, but only one of them got the physics

Who did it better?
